name: Unlocked counter loses increments under threads
modeled_on: A shared counter is incremented from multiple threads without a lock; `self.value += 1` is not atomic, so increments are lost. Real-world analogue: shared metrics/cache counters in threaded servers that drift from the true count under load.
hidden_bug: Counter.increment() does `self.value += 1` with no lock, so concurrent increments race and the final value is less than the number of increments.
expected_behavior: After N increments across threads, counter.value must equal exactly N.
ground_truth: Protect the increment with a lock (or use an atomic operation) so no increment is lost.

expected_patch.description: guard the increment with a lock
